This water footprint illustration provides a high-level view of our operational water use. The estimate for water use from our Tier 1 suppliers was drawn from our water footprint analysis completed in 2010. 
The estimate for water use from energy providers was updated using 2013 data and an updated methodology. The estimate incorporates our annual purchase of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs). 
Without RECs, our estimated Scope 2 water use would have been 3 billion gallons.
